queryAdapters.sourceSelectionPolicy: Select only existing approved or local-only knowledge source ids from the SEIS-owned classification fixture.
queryAdapters.rankingPolicy: Prefer official docs, then generated evaluation reports, then local fixture contracts, then planned metadata-only capacity records.
queryAdapters.redactionPolicy: Return metadata and evidence links only; never return raw file content, secrets, provider keys, archive bodies, embeddings, or private configuration.
queryAdapters.freshnessPolicy: Prefer current sources and mark needs-review or stale sources as blocked for this adapter.
queryAdapters.emptyState: No approved local metadata source matches this query.
allowedActions: summarize validation status from fixture records
forbiddenActions: execute push, merge, SSH, deployment, payment, or infrastructure actions

queryAdapters.sourceSelectionPolicy: Reject discarded assistant archive retrieval and allow only high-level clean-room triage references.
queryAdapters.rankingPolicy: No ranking is performed because this adapter is disabled for retrieval.
queryAdapters.redactionPolicy: Never return raw archive content, generated scripts, copied code, prompt dumps, model claims, or restricted behavior.
queryAdapters.freshnessPolicy: Treat discarded archive material as needs-review and blocked until a clean-room summary is approved.
queryAdapters.emptyState: Discarded assistant archive retrieval is blocked.
allowedActions: return risk category without copying implementation
forbiddenActions: copy source code or generated scripts
execute push, merge, SSH, deployment, payment, or infrastructure actions
claim BCI, consciousness upload, trained model, benchmark, checkpoint, or model-card evidence

nonClaims: No live provider adapter, provider call, model call, or provider quality claim is performed.
No provider key, SSH private key, token, cookie, environment-file value, or service credential is included.
No raw assistant archive, Qwen paste, generated script, or restricted implementation content is ingested.
No embedding index, vector database, or persistent memory write is created.
No GitHub push, merge, PR mutation, SSH command, deployment, payment, or infrastructure mutation is enabled.
No browser client receives provider secrets or privileged execution authority.
No benchmark, safety certification, trained model, checkpoint, model-card, BCI, or SEIS-owned model claim is created.
No absolute machine path or /Users evidence path is allowed.
